crossRefs.note: Those who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against Yahweh their God, who brought them up out of the land of…
because they didn’t obey Yahweh their God’s voice, but transgressed his covenant, even all that Moses the servant of…
“Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,
Hear Yahweh’s word, you children of Israel; for Yahweh has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there…
There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes…
Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls…
They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold…
Now they sin more and more, and have made themselves molten images of their silver, even idols according to their own…
Therefore they will be like the morning mist, and like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven…
Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?
Therefore, because you trample on the poor, and take taxes from him of wheat: You have built houses of cut stone, but…
For I know how many your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who…
Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;
who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!
who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for the arbiter in the gate, and who deprive the innocent…
and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you may remove them…
You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;
who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals;
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Israel, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they sell the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;
translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Israel, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes-
